options.name: Server IP
options.description: Shown in the info board under the hero with a click-to-copy button.

options.name: Discord invite
options.description: Full invite URL. Used in the info board, the help panel and the footer.

options.name: Main site
options.description: Link back to the main CaelumSMP website from the footer.

options.name: Kicker
options.description: The small label above the headline.

options.name: Headline
options.description: The big headline. Wrap a word in <em> to make it lime.

options.name: Intro paragraph
options.description: Shown under the headline. Ignored if the store's homepage content (Storefront > Pages) is filled in, which takes priority.
options.default: Every purchase keeps CaelumSMP online and ad-free. Perks land in-game within a minute.

options.name: Most popular row
options.description: Comma-separated package names shown in a highlighted row above the categories, so a visitor sees something buyable without scrolling. Names must match the packages exactly. Leave empty to hide the row.

options.name: "Best value" ribbon
options.description: One package name. Gets a lime corner ribbon everywhere it appears.

options.name: "Most popular" ribbon
options.description: Comma-separated package names. Each gets a coral corner ribbon. A package with the Best value ribbon ignores this one.

options.name: Quantity categories
options.description: Comma-separated category names whose packages are bought in multiples - crate keys, consumables, currency. Those packages get a quantity stepper and x5 / x10 / x25 shortcuts. Leave empty to turn quantity off everywhere.

options.name: Delivery time
options.description: Short phrase for the info board, e.g. "Under a minute".

options.name: Delivery note
options.description: The 'Instant delivery' panel near the bottom of the store front.
options.default: Perks are applied automatically, usually within a minute. Be online or just log in afterwards.

options.name: Refund policy
options.description: The 'Refunds' panel. Keep it short - the full terms are shown at checkout.
options.default: All payments are final. Chargebacks result in a permanent ban across the network.

options.name: Support note
options.description: The 'Need a hand?' panel. The Discord link is appended automatically if one is set above.
options.default: Didn't get your purchase? Open a ticket and we'll sort it.
